---
name: Architecture Documents
description: "Use when creating or reviewing architecture plans, ADRs, diagrams, API contracts, data models, or technical decision documents."
applyTo: "**/docs/**/*.{md,mdx},**/adr/**/*.md,**/architecture/**/*.md"
---
# Architecture Documentation

- State goals, scope, assumptions, constraints, alternatives, consequences, and revisit triggers.
- Separate current state, proposed state, and decisions still requiring confirmation.
- Describe trust boundaries, failure modes, observability, migration, and rollback.
- Use diagrams or structured tables when they clarify ownership and data flow.
- Do not present an unverified technology choice as settled.
